props.gloss_en: one who carries out foods the size of a dried fig is liable
and they [the foods] join with one another
because they are equal in their measures
except their shells [which do not join to the measure]
and [except] their pits and their stems
and [except] their bran and their coarse bran
R' Yehuda: except the shells of lentils [which do join]
five quarters of flour and a bit more are obligated in challa -- they and their bran and their coarse bran
Abaye: since a poor man eats his bread in mixed dough
the baraita: R' Yehuda says, except the shells of beans and lentils
this [the baraita, where bean shells join] is with new ones
this [the mishna, where only lentil shells join] is with old ones
R' Abbahu: [old beans' shells do not join] because they look like flies in the dish

objections.gloss_en: וסובן ומורסנן לא מצטרפין? והתנן: חמשת רבעים קמח ועוד חייבין בחלה הן וסובן ומורסנן -- for challa, bran and coarse bran count toward the measure

answered_by.gloss_en: שכן עני אוכל פתו בעיסה בלוסה -- for challa they count, since a poor man eats bread of mixed dough (= p_ab_ani_isa_belusa)

objections.gloss_en: עדשים אין, פולין לא? והתניא, רבי יהודה אומר: חוץ מקליפי פולין ועדשים -- the mishna's R' Yehuda names lentils alone, the baraita's names beans too

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא בחדתי, הא בעתיקי -- the baraita speaks of new beans, the mishna of old ones (= p_okimta_baraita_chadtei, p_okimta_matnitin_atikei)
